objectives.name: Crippling Blow
objectives.rulesText: At least 3 health worth of Imperial ground units have been destroyed in a combat that you initiated.

objectives.name: Cut Supply Lines
objectives.rulesText: At least 3 Imperial systems contain either a sabotage marker or a Rebel unit.

objectives.name: Defend The People
objectives.rulesText: At least 4 Rebel systems contain a Rebel unit.

objectives.name: Rebel Assault
objectives.rulesText: A Star Destroyer or Super Star Destroyer has been destroyed in a combat that you initiated.

objectives.name: Regional Support
objectives.rulesText: All populous systems in 1 region have Rebel loyalty.

objectives.name: Death Star Plans
objectives.rulesText: If there is at least 1 fighter after the space battle step, reveal this card to roll 3 dice. If you roll a direct hit, play this card and destroy a Death Star in this system. Otherwise return this card to your hand.

objectives.name: Heart Of The Empire
objectives.rulesText: If the Coruscant system contains a Rebel unit and no Imperial units. Then return this card to your hand.

objectives.name: Leave No One Behind
objectives.rulesText: If there are no captured Rebel leaders.

objectives.name: Liberation
objectives.rulesText: If you win a ground battle in a subjugated system.

objectives.name: Popular Support
objectives.rulesText: If at least 6 systems have Rebel loyalty.

objectives.name: Death Star Plans
objectives.rulesText: If there is at least 1 fighter after the space battle step, reveal this card to roll 3 dice. If you roll a direct hit, play this card and destroy a Death Star in this system. Otherwise return this card to your hand.

objectives.name: Establish Outposts
objectives.rulesText: At least 5 systems contain a Rebel unit.

objectives.name: Inspire Sympathy
objectives.rulesText: Gain 1 reputation for each destroyed system. [Variable reputation; field 'reputation' here is 0 as a placeholder.]

objectives.name: Major Victory
objectives.rulesText: At least 3 health worth of Imperial ships have been destroyed in a combat that you initiated.

objectives.name: Return Of The Jedi
objectives.rulesText: After you win a battle in Darth Vader's or Emperor Palpatine's system. If Luke Skywalker (Jedi) is in this system, eliminate 1 Imperial leader in this system.

objectives.name: Decisive Victory
objectives.rulesText: Win a space battle and a ground battle in the same combat.

objectives.name: Defensive Position
objectives.rulesText: A single system (other than the Rebel Base space) contains 3 Rebel structures.

objectives.name: Support of the Hutts
objectives.rulesText: 3 or more systems in Nal Hutta's region have Rebel loyalty.

objectives.name: The Long War
objectives.rulesText: Discard 2 other objective cards from your hand.

objectives.name: Threaten the Core
objectives.rulesText: 5 or more Rebel units are in and/or adjacent to Coruscant.

objectives.name: A Time for Peace
objectives.rulesText: Destroy 2 triangle, 1 circle, and 1 square unit on the Rebel build queue to play this card.

objectives.name: Raid Outposts
objectives.rulesText: Imperial player places 1 target marker in each of 2 remote systems. Rebel gains 1 reputation each time a marker is removed (potential 1–2 total).

objectives.name: Rebel Cell
objectives.rulesText: Place a target marker in a Rebel system. If the marker is still there at the start of each Refresh phase, discard 1 objective card to gain 1 reputation.

objectives.name: Seize Control
objectives.rulesText: Win a space or ground battle in a system with a sabotage marker. You may then remove the marker.

objectives.name: Raid Imperial Factory
objectives.rulesText: Play after you win a battle during a combat that you initiated in a system that has a ■ (square) resource icon.

objectives.name: Show No Fear
objectives.rulesText: Place a target marker in the Rebel Base's system. Remove it when a new base is established. If the marker is still present at the start of each Refresh phase, gain 1 reputation.

objectives.name: Uprising
objectives.rulesText: Play if 9 or more systems have Rebel loyalty.
